slides.title: Non-defining relative clauses
slides.subtitle: Adding extra information with commas
goals: Add extra information with **who, which, whose, where**.
Know that **that** is not used here.

head: Type
Example
Note
rows: The man **who lives next door** is a doctor.
My father, **who is 60**, still plays football.
Ana, **whose brother is a pilot**, travels a lot.

errors.bad: Querétaro, that is in central Mexico, is beautiful.
errors.good: Querétaro, **which** is in central Mexico, is beautiful.

items.q: My sister, ___ lives in Canada, is visiting us.
The Peña de Bernal, ___ is a huge monolith, attracts many tourists.
Frida Kahlo, ___ paintings are famous, was born in Coyoacán.

items.t: Mr. Díaz is our teacher. He speaks four languages. → Mr. Díaz, ___ speaks four languages, is our teacher.
I visited Guanajuato. My grandmother was born there. → I visited Guanajuato, ___ my grandmother was born.
